summary: community.general for Ansible 15 requires ansible-core 2.19+, removed jboss (use the wildfly role), and turned keycloak_authentication* and authz modules into redirects requiring middleware_automation.keycloak.
questions: Why does keycloak_authentication fail after upgrading to Ansible 15?
Which ansible-core does community.general need in Ansible 15?

answer_card.title: community.general removals in Ansible 15 (part 1)
answer_card.answer_md:
- Requires **ansible-core 2.19.0+** (2.18 dropped).
- `jboss` removed; use the **`middleware_automation.wildfly.wildfly_app_deploy`** role.

These community.general modules are now **redirects** to `middleware_automation.keycloak`. The redirect only works if you **install `middleware_automation.keycloak`**:

```bash
ansible-galaxy collection install middleware_automation.keycloak
```

Affected modules (each maps to `middleware_automation.keycloak.<name>`):

`keycloak_authentication`, `keycloak_authentication_required_actions`, `keycloak_authentication_v2`, `keycloak_authz_authorization_scope`, `keycloak_authz_custom_policy`
